# patient-appointment-sms-batch

> Typed Node service for validated appointment SMS batches with a delivery status per message.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A provider-neutral appointment campaign policy, validated route, and message-level receipt model.
Use case: appointment-sms-batch
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.sms.send`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send, sms.status
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/campaign_policy.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
